author: VanZandtVS
body:
Cast Ward of Ortanite on the first turn to help with mitigating damage.   Next turn, pick a mob you can one-shot and murder it to start clearing the field.   At this point you're just trying to make the incoming damage manageable till you can get your buffs up.  Watch your HP.  When there's only a couple mobs left, start your buff rotation. 

Once you've got your buffs and Divine Bastion 2 up, and about 40-ish turns of Ward, the rest of the dungeon is easy peasy.

author: Apprehensive-Nose646
body:
I'm kind of over it. I'm burning through potions to stay alive in horde dungeons and never seem to have a chance for anything good to drop. They don't even have bosses on the last floor. As a new tier 10 I feel like I'm getting robbed of chances at arisen gods. I decided to try chronomancer since the lacunus spell is made for horde dungeons, but I dropped it pretty quickly because there was hardly any payback for all I was giving up. 

Here are my suggestions:

1. Set the first floor so that it is always playable. I get like a petrify caster, a sleep caster, and a berserk and I'm supposed to beat them before I even have my buffs up?
2. Set the final floor so that it always has a boss with a decent drop like the regular dungeons have. I feel like I shouldn't be preferring regular dungeons if the themed dungeons are supposed to be special more orns isn't enough.
3. Buff chronomancer. At the very least it needs more skill slots. Right now it has more skills to incorporate into fewer slots vs sequencer or maji. And make it so health draining debuffs only hit once per turn when casting lacunus. I can't even play with a chimera the way it is now taking a hit for every monster in the room. It is hard enough negotiating debuffs in horde dungeons in a room with several casting them on you, having them hit you 4 or 5 times per cast is brutal, it can easily hit for several thousand, and it kind of takes away the only reason to use this specialization.

author: msg45f
body: I am enjoying them a lot. I really like the gameplay of having multiple enemies rather than 1v1. Normal dungeons feel bland and easy by comparison now. I do think that there should be some considerations of rethinking how certain debuffs work though. In a single round I went from taking 0 damage from all enemies, to being immediately killed because I got both defense- and defense-- at once. I think these debuffs were okay when at most you were going to get hit once per round, but now getting hit 3-5 times they can be instant death.

author: Tavmania
body:
I consider Battlegrounds the most fun of the themed dungeons, even when playing alone. Then again, I play as a Heretic with all kinds of specs and start the fight with Ward of Ortanite. That's a pretty big factor in succeeding the first round.  

The tricky part about Battlegrounds is also that status ailments run rampant, with everyone spamming elemental attacks. Ring of Annwn may be more recommended instead of trying to yolo it through with 2 Band of Gods. On top of that, lower-tier mobs get significantly upscaled, with a high chance of berserks.  

Heretic Maji isn't necessarily more reliable than Realmshifter Ranger. Baldr uses Parry, which deals you the dealt dmg back. So using AoE's that don't kill him, gives him the ammo to kill you.
